text:
alice: Quick heads up — planning to run the tenant-index backfill during the 23:00 UTC deploy window tonight. Need to pin the service deploy to v2.3.1 for the duration to avoid canary mismatch. I want a clear rollback/abort signal if we hit lock contention.
ben: Do we expect long table locks? what’s the estimated lock time per shard?
sasha: Expect brief exclusive lock only for the DDL swap (~100-300ms), but backfill will touch ~25M rows spread across shards. We'll run staged small batches with rate cap. Abort criteria: any primary seeing lock wait >30s for >3 shards in a 5m window -> abort.
deploybot: Scheduled migration job created by alice at 2026-03-22T22:45:12Z. Job ID: mig-20260322-tnidx-01. Stagger=200, batch_size=200, rate_limit=1200r/s. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/mig-runbooks/tnidx-backfill
```bash
./deploybot run-migration --id mig-20260322-tnidx-01 --stagger 200 --batch 200 --rate 1200
```
tim: Add an immediate escape hatch command in case of adverse impact: `/deploybot abort-migration mig-20260322-tnidx-01 --force`. We should make it a documented runbook step and have infra on standby.
infra-bot: FYI: yesterday we saw a 2x lock wait spike during the hourly batch at 22:00 UTC. Recommend turning on traffic-shim for 10m before the migration and enabling read-only fallbacks for non-critical endpoints. Metrics: https://grafana.redwood/d/locks/lock-waits
ben: Also add a release-note bullet: "Tenant-index online swap + controlled backfill (v2.3.1) — will be rate-limited; endpoints may see brief elevated latencies."
alice: Good call. I'll add to release notes and pin the deploy. Can infra add pre-window traffic-shim job to route 20% of traffic to canary for 10m prior? If shims look good, we ramp to 0% drain and proceed. Need ACK from oncall and infra.
sasha: ACK :thumbsup: I'll monitor backfill progress and run a manual pause if error rate creeps above 1%.
ben: Can we lower batch_size to 150 to be safer? small perf hit but lower risk.
alice: Ok change accepted — update job to batch_size=150. deploybot, update job.
deploybot: Job mig-20260322-tnidx-01 updated: batch_size=150, stagger=200, rate_limit=1200. Scheduled start 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z. Will attempt to acquire migration lock at start.
infra-bot: Pre-window shim job scheduled at 2026-03-22T22:50:00Z to route 20% to canary for 10m. Oncall: @sasha @tim please standby.
tim: Oncall standby. I'll be in #eng-oncall and reachable by phone.
alice: Final checklist: pin service to v2.3.1, release-note updated, escape hatch command copied to pager, pre-window shim in place, abort threshold set (lock wait >30s x3). If no objections, we'll proceed with the window.
sasha: No objections. proceeding on schedule. :rocket:
deploybot: Reminder: keep `mig-20260322-tnidx-01` runbook open. If abort issued, deploybot will roll back the swap and mark job as aborted in CI.
